schemaContract:
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'postmaster_started_at',pg_postmaster_start_time(),'observed_at',clock_timestamp(),'wal_lsn',pg_current_wal_lsn(),
 'roles',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',rolname,'superuser',rolsuper,'bypassrls',rolbypassrls,'inherit',rolinherit,'login',rolcanlogin,'create_role',rolcreaterole,'create_db',rolcreatedb) ORDER BY rolname) FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname IN ('musitu_runtime','musitu_ingress','musitu_commands')),
 'relations',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'relation',c.relname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),'rls',c.relrowsecurity,'force_rls',c.relforcerowsecurity,'acl',c.relacl::text) ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('musitu','musitu_identity') AND c.relkind='r'),
 'schema_hash',encode(sha256(convert_to(jsonb_build_object(
 'columns',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) ORDER BY x.table_schema,x.table_name,x.ordinal_position) FROM (SELECT table_schema,table_name,column_name,ordinal_position,data_type,is_nullable,column_default FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema IN ('musitu','musitu_identity')) x),
 'policies',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) ORDER BY x.schemaname,x.tablename,x.policyname) FROM pg_policies x WHERE schemaname IN ('musitu','musitu_identity')),
 'constraints',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'table',c.relname,'name',co.conname,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(co.oid)) ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname,co.conname) FROM pg_constraint co JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=co.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('musitu','musitu_identity')),
 'functions',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('signature',p.oid::regprocedure::text,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),'acl',p.proacl::text,'definition',pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) ORDER BY p.oid::regprocedure::text) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('musitu','musitu_identity'))
 )::text,'UTF8')),'hex')
) AS contract;
